title.zh: Google重回第一梯队：Gemini 4 Argon追平GPT-6 Astra
title.en: Google重回第一梯队：Gemini 4 Argon追平GPT-6 Astra

current_state.zh: Artificial Analysis' independent evaluation finds Google's Gemini 4 Argon ties GPT-6 Astra on the Intelligence Index at 53 points with a far lower hallucination rate (15%) and cheaper introductory API costs, though full-price costs and answer accuracy lag Astra.
current_state.en: Artificial Analysis' independent evaluation finds Google's Gemini 4 Argon ties GPT-6 Astra on the Intelligence Index at 53 points with a far lower hallucination rate (15%) and cheaper introductory API costs, though full-price costs and answer accuracy lag Astra.
